long_biography.plain_text:
After studying at the University of Sussex, Glenister entered storage and materials handling. That experience showed him an opportunity in the emerging self-storage market, and in 1995 he acted on it by establishing a purpose-built business in south-east England. Its early focus on specialised facilities positioned the company for steady regional expansion.

Easistore ultimately operated four properties across Kent and Sussex, with land assembled for a fifth location. The owners reorganised the group before Nuveen Real Estate bought the trading portfolio for £83 million in April 2023. They kept the separate development land rather than include it in the transaction, preserving scope for future projects after the exit.
